text:
oncall-bot: ALERT: automated canary checker: increased 5xx rate on eu-west rungroup during staged rollout v2.3 -> 30% errors on canary traffic. paging @alex. incident_id=RWD-2026-042

alex: got it, looking now. which pool is affected? canary = runtime-eu-canary-3 right?

carla: yes runtime-eu-canary-3. we pushed a kernel-selection tweak for kv-cache earlier in the rollout (v2.3). seeing repeated segfaults in the canary logs.

jin: paging in from SRE. I'm tailing the canary logs now. early signs point to a CUDA kernel mismatch on one instance type (a100p-80). stacktrace looks like runtime kernel OOB then process restart -> 502s.

carla: copying relevant log snippet:
```
[2026-03-15T02:10:12Z] runtime: segfault at 0x7fffd2c, pc=0x7f9a2bff
#0 0x7f9a2bff in kv_cache_update+0x1a4 (libruntime.so)
#1 0x7f9a3c12 in infer_step+0x2b0
#2 0x55aa8d in worker_loop+0x120
```
we reproduced on a spare canary node with the same binary.

alex: thanks. immediate mitigation options? rollback or kill the feature flag for kernel-selection?

marta: we have a feature flag gate (ff:kernel-auto) that flips to older kernel selection. I can flip it for the region but need approval to apply to live canary rollout.

jin: priority = protect customer traffic. suggested: 1) stop further canary promotion 2) flip ff:kernel-auto -> legacy on canary nodes 3) abort staged rollout if errors persist 4) start rollback of canary image to v2.2 if necessary.

deploy-bot: rollout v2.3 started by @carla at 2026-03-15T02:05:12Z, current progress: 12% global, eu-west canary 10% -> paused: false.

liz: support note: first customer reports arrived ~02:12Z — embedded search and chat failing with 502s for a small subset (EU accounts). Roughly 120 support tickets hitting in the last 15m, priority customers included. sending interim message to BizOps.

oliver: PM here — we should assume customer-visible outage until we confirm otherwise. please call out ETA for mitigation and whether we'll need an external status page update.

alex: flipping ff:kernel-auto -> legacy for runtime-eu-canary-3 now. marta, please confirm when toggle applied.

marta: toggled ff:kernel-auto=legacy for runtime-eu-canary-3. command used:
```bash
rwd-ffctl set kernel-auto legacy --scope runtime-eu-canary-3 --by alex
```
awaiting warmup.

carla: confirming — I'm redeploying a patched image with tighter CUDA checks to the canary as well, but that will take ~8-12m.

jin: checking metrics. 5xx rate dropping on the flagged canary within 90s of the flag flip. good signal.

oncall-bot: NOTE: auto-retry suppression enabled for canary group to avoid storming.

alex: good. alex -> jin taking lead for rollback if the flag flip doesn't fully recover. carla, hold off on global promotion until we validate for 30m.

liz: crafting customer-facing note: short one-liner + we are investigating, impacted EU users for some chat/search responses. want me to post to status.rwd.com after SRE confirms partial mitigation?

oliver: yes please wait for green signal before public post. we'll want a cautious message but not alarmist.

jin: preliminary recovery numbers: error spike fell from 32% -> 8% on canary within 3m of flag flip. but one node still showing occasional restarts (oom/segfault). pinning that host out of rotation.

carla: removing the unhealthy canary instance now:
```bash
rwd-infra evict-instance --id i-eu-canary-03a --dry-run=false
```
should replace with fresh instance on legacy kernel.

deploy-bot: instance i-eu-canary-03a evicted, replacement starting.

marta: replaced instance booted and joined canary pool, health checks passing.

jin: traffic now at normal error rate for canary (<=1%). rolling hold for 30m to monitor. if stable, we'll resume staged rollout but with kernel-auto off globally until patch lands.

alex: handoff: I'm going offline in 20m. jin and carla you own the rest of the mitigation and the rollback plan if we see >5% errors again. I'll update oncall rotation and add incident to follow-up.

carla: acknowledged. I'll prepare the v2.2 rollback playbook in case, and start the regression test run against EU traffic replay. ETA ~25m for test results.

liz: internal summary for support: "Mitigation: feature-flagged kernel selection to legacy for canary; evicted one unhealthy instance; monitoring shows recovery. Actions: hold rollout, prepare rollback to v2.2, post external update if we reach steady state or if rollback is required." sending now to support queue.

oliver: thanks — please schedule postmortem once we close. communication owner = liz. timeline owner = carla.

jin: adding final note: we'll open a short incident ticket and tag runtime-kernel, infra, and perf teams. preliminary cause likely kernel-selection + specific GPU driver combo.

alex: closing loop: canary stable at 02:52Z, error rate back to baseline. incident status -> mitigating. leaving handoff note in #oncall-handoffs. :white_check_mark:

marta: logging FF change for audit: rwd-ffctl log --id RWD-2026-042 --change "kernel-auto -> legacy on runtime-eu-canary-3"

oncall-bot: ACTION REQUIRED: please create incident ticket PRD-2026-042 and attach logs + playbook.

carla: will create the incident ticket and attach reproducer + logs within 1h.

alex: thanks team. will follow up in the morning for postmortem.
